title: Protocol document
description: Validates a protocol document after check_schemas.py has converted it to {front_matter, sections}: front_matter is the parsed YAML front matter, sections is the list of level-2 heading texts in document order. A protocol document states the condition that triggers a procedure, its ordered steps, how to confirm it finished, and what to do when a step fails. The schema checks that each section exists, not that Steps is a numbered list.
